headline: Public hearing on the EOHLC FY2027 Annual Plan, plus a $178,280 accounting contract and a $328,785 change order for Toepfert Apartments.
summary: The agenda includes a public hearing on the FY2027 Annual Plan. Other business covers rent payment standards, accounting and clerk of the works contracts, and change orders for several construction projects.
items: HUD 2027 Fair Market Rents and HHA payment standards starting January 1, 2027
Fee accountant contract for 2027 to 2028 to Fenton and Ewald Associates, $178,280
South Holyoke Homes Phase III clerk of the works contract to DBM Enterprises Inc, $87,500
Submission of the FY2027 EOHLC Annual Plan
Toepfert Security Improvement change order, no cost, adds 88 days
Rosary Under Slab Piping and First Floor Modifications change order, $28,837, adds 14 days to substantial completion
Toepfert Apartments Unit Modifications change order, $328,785, adds 70 days, plus $32,000 in MTW funding flexibility
Current issues reports from nine departments, open for discussion
Executive summary, new business, and executive session
plain_text:
HOLYOKE HOUSING AUTHORITY REGULAR BOARD MEETING 
And 
EOHLC Annual Plan Hearing 
Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 12:00 PM 
475 Maple Street, Holyoke, MA 
 
 
AGENDA: 
 
• EOHLC Annual Plan Hearing 
 
• HHA Regular Board Meeting 
 
1) To approve minutes of the October 8, 2026 meeting.  
  2025 Audit Presentation 
 
A) RESOLUTIONS: 
 
1. HUD 2027 Fair Market Rents (FMR) and HHA Payment Standards 
 
● To authorize staff to apply the 2027 HUD FMR as HHA’s Payment Standards 
starting January 1, 2027. 
 
2. Fee Accountant Contract Award 
 
● To award the Fee Accountant contract for the time period of January 1, 2027 to 
December 31 2028 to Fenton and Ewald Associates in the amount of $178,280. 
 
3. South Holyoke Homes Phase III Clerk of the Works 
 
● To award the Clerk of the Works contract to DBM Enterprises Inc in the amount of 
$87,500. 
 
4. Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities Annual Plan submission 
  
• Approve submission of the FY2027 Annual Plan as written or as amended by 
comments gathered during the public hearing. 
 
5. Toepfert Security Improvement Contract  
 
• Approve no cost Change Order One increasing the contract time by 88 days. 
 
6. Rosary Under Slab Piping and First Floor Modifications 
 
• Approve Change Order No. 1 in the amount of $28,837 increasing the contract 
amount from $1,347,175 to $1,376,012 and extending the Substantial Completion 
14 days from January 4 to January 18, 2027. 
 
7. Toepfert Apartments Unit Modifications 
 
• Approve Change Order Two in the amount of $328,785 increasing the contract to 
$737,935 from $409,150 and extending the contract by 70 days. 
• Approve an additional $32,000 of MTW funding flexibility.
B) CURRENT ISSUES REPORTS (open for discussion) 
1) Maintenance/Admissions 
2) Modernization Report 
3) Development Report 
4) Finance Department Report 
5) Resident Services Report 
6) Leased Housing 
7) MIS Department 
8) Senior Property Manager Report 
9) Human Resources Report 
 
C) EXECUTIVE SUMMARY  
D) NEW BUSINESS  
E) EXECUTIVE SESSION  
F) ADJOURN 
 
The listing of matters is those anticipated by the Chair, which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed 
may in fact be discussed, and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted 
by law.
